scope: candidate audit of polished-backup.js against planned provider-per-chat/preferences, workflow pending/receipts, and workspaceTools.automation state
decision: Needs narrow schema extensions before integrating the planned state. Do not normalize unknown fields broadly.

findings.evidence: PREF_FIELDS is an allowlist and validate rejects unknown prefs; envelope filters unknown prefs (lines 8, 32, 65). Chat records are otherwise structurally preserved, so a provider/model selection stored on a chat survives validation unless it is placed in a queue item.
findings.requiredChange: Add the exact planned preference field names and bounded validation to PREF_FIELDS/validate/envelope. Preserve provider/model fields on chat records only if they are part of the committed state contract.
findings.risk: An unlisted preference field is rejected on import and silently omitted from export.

findings.evidence: Each pendingQueue item is rebuilt with only id, text, createdAt, replyTo and mode (line 47). The graph/exportSafe path preserves safe arbitrary record fields elsewhere.
findings.requiredChange: If pending workflow or receipt fields live in pendingQueue entries, extend the queue item allowlist with exact bounded fields and validate their types. If they live under data or a chat record, add explicit validation only where needed.
findings.risk: Workflow pending/receipt metadata inside queue entries is dropped during import validation and queue restore.

findings.evidence: workspaceTools validation only iterates ideas and goals (lines 52-55). Add-mode merge remaps only ideas and goals (lines 81-85); Replace retains the cloned data.
findings.requiredChange: Add a narrow automation schema/limit and remap/merge branch alongside ideas/goals, preserving safe automation fields and chat references. Keep imported queues paused as today.
findings.risk: Replace keeps automation, but Add-mode import drops incoming data.workspaceTools.automation.

preservation.pinnedAt: Verified in UX-052: a valid Add-mode backup with pinned:true, pinnedAt and a paused pending queue restored with pinnedAt unchanged, while the existing a1 history remained byte-for-byte equivalent by message IDs.
preservation.privateKeyFilter: Keep graph/exportSafe private-key rejection; no credentials or connection controls should be admitted.
preservation.connectionControls: validate still forces browser/computer false; preserve this safety behavior.
preservation.transaction: replace still snapshots all KEYS before writes and recovers pending imports; preserve this transaction path.
preservation.recommendation: Resolve exact planned field names from the integrated state model, then make narrow replacements. Do not broaden normalizeQueueItem or workspace merge to copy arbitrary fields.
